Name: Remove All Monsters
Author: dejelly
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]

A simple mod that despawns all monsters from all locations in the game. 

Tested on Stardew Valley 1.4.5 for both single player and multiplayer.

[size=5]Usage[/size]

All monsters will be removed automatically when a player enters a new location.  Monsters may be visible briefly before de-spawning, or may make sounds as they de-spawn.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI.
[*] Works in single player and multiplayer.  In multiplayer, as long as at least one player has the mod, all monsters will be removed for all players.
[/list]
[size=5]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download the Remove All Monsters mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]. To find your game folder, see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]this table[/url].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
